# Search profiles

*Feature* · also written Search profile

A profile in Google Search where publishers and creators show their work and channels in one place.

**Glossary** (*Search profile*): A profile publishers and creators can claim in Google Search, with name, photo, bio, links and pinned posts, which users can follow. In the US, 10,000 followers across YouTube, Instagram, X or TikTok qualify since 16 September 2026. Its verified accounts are added automatically as Search Console platform properties.

Narrative: the topic [Search profiles](../topics/search-profiles.md) tells the story; this card lists what links to it.

7 claims mention it: 3 from Google's documentation, 2 shown or said at the event (1 not in Google docs, 1 confirmed by Google docs), 2 the author's analysis. A card is a map: cite the claim ids, with the citation given after each claim.

## Google's documentation

Documented in: [A new profile to help publishers and creators highlight their work on Search](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/a-new-profile-to-help-publishers-and-creators-highlight-their-work-on-search/), [3 new ways we're improving Search profiles for publishers](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/3-new-ways-were-improving-search-profiles-for-publishers/), [Manage your Search profile](https://support.google.com/websearch/answer/16904750?hl=en).

- [`D1-C026`](../sessions/D1-S02-what-s-new-in-the-world-of-search.md) Docs: Search profiles launched on 4 June 2026, in the US first, for creators and publishers with a sizable following on at least one major social or video platform. They appear in knowledge panels and Discover. `[D1-C026, docs, Google blog (4 June 2026), https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/a-new-profile-to-help-publishers-and-creators-highlight-their-work-on-search/]`
- [`D1-C125`](../sessions/D1-S02-what-s-new-in-the-world-of-search.md) Docs: Since 16 September 2026, US publishers and creators qualify for a Search profile with 10,000 followers across YouTube, Instagram, X or TikTok, and media organisations can claim and manage profiles for all their sub-brands from one login. `[D1-C125, docs, Google blog (16 September 2026), https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/3-new-ways-were-improving-search-profiles-for-publishers/]`
- [`D3-C468`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Docs: Google's social and video performance guide says that if you already claimed your Search profile, all of its verified accounts are added automatically as platform properties in Search Console. `[D3-C468, docs, Google Search Central, https://developers.google.com/search/docs/monitor-debug/analyze-social-video-content]`

## Shown or said at the event

Not in Google's documentation first: present those as said at Search Central Live, never as documented policy.

- [`D1-C023`](../sessions/D1-S02-what-s-new-in-the-world-of-search.md) Slide, Day 1, not in Google docs: Google listed eight ways AI Search helps users find and visit websites: preferred sources expansion, fresh perspectives and prominent links, subscription content, in-line quotes in AI Mode and AI Overviews, rich linking and embedded web, context on content sources, 'Highly Cited' labels and Search profiles. `[D1-C023, slide, Google, Day 1]`
- [`D1-C025`](../sessions/D1-S02-what-s-new-in-the-world-of-search.md) Slide, Day 1, confirmed by Google docs: Publishers and creators can claim a dedicated Search profile with a name, profile photo, cover image, bio, connected social and website accounts, pinned posts and links, and users can follow it. `[D1-C025, slide, Google, Day 1]`

## The author's analysis

- [`D1-C028`](../sessions/D1-S02-what-s-new-in-the-world-of-search.md) Analysis: Preferred sources, linked subscriptions and Search profiles all depend on users acting on a brand's behalf. They reward brands with a loyal audience and do little for anonymous lead-generation sites. `[D1-C028, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`
- [`D3-C453`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Analysis: Media teams that publish on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok or X should add each account as a Search Console platform property and compare formats by URL pattern; Google's July 2026 post says an account already used for a Search profile should already give access to its data. `[D3-C453, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`
